name: Ou Khatta
instructions: 1. Peel and slice the Ou Tenga, then boil it in water until soft and drain the excess water.
3. Heat mustard oil in a pan and add mustard seeds and dry red chilies to temper.
4. Add the mashed Ou Tenga, turmeric powder, and salt, stirring well.
5. Add jaggery and cook on low heat until the mixture thickens and achieves a jam-like consistency.
6. Remove from heat and serve as a palate cleanser or side dish.
description: Ou Khatta is a quintessential Assamese delicacy made from Elephant Apple (Ou Tenga). It is traditionally served at the end of a meal to act as a digestive aid and palate cleanser due to its distinctively tart flavor profile balanced by the sweetness of jaggery.
